title: SIRI KUCING EMAS & STORYBOARD EMAS (3 SCENE / BATCH) — SET 3

guide.h: Pengenalan Konsep & Struktur Siri (Set 3: Realiti Malaysia)

items: Format 3 Scene Berangkai: Setiap batch mengandungi arka penceritaan 3 klip video bersiri (10 saat setiap satu). Scene 1 dan Scene 2 menampilkan animasi 3D keluarga kucing Calico menghadapi isu kewangan sebenar di Malaysia, manakala Scene 3 disambung secara langsung oleh hos wanita live-action yang merumuskan iktibar kisah kucing tersebut dan memberikan jalan keluar kewangan melalui simpanan emas fizikal Public Gold.

Strict Zero Gold Rule (Scene 1 & Scene 2): Visual emas fizikal (jongkong, syiling, dinar, barang kemas) dilarang sama sekali dalam Scene 1 dan Scene 2. Perkataan 'emas' atau 'gold' dilarang disebut dalam dialog Scene 1 dan Scene 2. Fokus penuh diberikan kepada drama emosi, realiti ekonomi keluarga, kos hidup, dan penyelesaian praktikal. Emas hanya muncul dalam Scene 3.

Peraturan Wajib Lengan Panjang & Handsocks (Scene 3): Mematuhi syarat aurat sempurna dan peraturan wajib lengan baju labuh hingga pergelangan tangan serta handsocks berpadanan menutup pergelangan tangan di ketiga-tiga blok mandatori: Main Character / Subject, Requirements, dan Video Prompt Consistency.
Larangan Tabung Babi (No Piggy Bank): Sebarang elemen tabung babi dilarang sama sekali di seluruh babak dan papan cerita.

Disiplin Had Masa & Dialog Pantas: Video tepat 10 saat. Dialog Scene 1 & 2 tepat 4 baris, 18 hingga 22 patah perkataan dalam Bahasa Melayu santai. Dialog Scene 3 tepat 4 baris, 15 hingga 20 patah perkataan, dan sama persis dengan panel storyboard (Panel 2, 3, 5, 8).

Giliran Seimbang 6 Gaya Bukaan Scene 3: Bagi memastikan variasi dinamik merentas 30 set, gaya bukaan Scene 3 digilirkan secara seimbang merentas 6 format (Situasi Harian, Pengakuan Silap, Jawab Bantahan, Soalan + Reveal, Milestone, Sasaran Persona) tanpa mengulang gaya yang sama 3 kali berturut-turut.

guide.h: BAHAGIAN 0: CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET (INGREDIENT GOOGLE FLOW)

guide.p: Jana imej rujukan di bawah untuk disimpan sebagai Ingredient watak dalam Google Flow bagi memastikan konsistensi bulu dan rupa bentuk watak keluarga kucing merentas semua batch:
Character reference sheet of a Malaysian domestic cat family, 3D animated feature film style.

items: Mother (Ibu): Adult calico cat, vibrant tri-color fur of warm ginger-orange, deep black patches, and clean white chest and paws; expressive emerald-green almond eyes, plush bushy tail, gentle and maternal facial expression.
Kitten 1 (Oren): Energetic bright ginger-orange tabby kitten, large round sapphire-blue eyes, white muzzle, playful and curious posture.
Kitten 2 (Kelabu): Thoughtful silver-grey tabby kitten with dark charcoal stripes, slightly oversized ears, observant honey-amber eyes.
Kitten 3 (Coklat): Smallest runt kitten, soft chocolate-brown marbled coat, big innocent hazel eyes, shy and clingy.
Kitten 4 (Putih): Pure pristine snow-white kitten, bright round lemon-yellow eyes, pink nose pads, dainty and lively.

guide.p: Setting: Cozy Malaysian single-story terrace living room with polished teak wood flooring, wooden slatted louvre blinds, warm late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight filtering in, lush green potted tropical plants in the corner.
Style: Premium 3D animation, soft tactile fur grooming detail, subsurface scattering on ears, shallow depth of field, warm cinematic color grading.
Vertical 9:16 composition. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no subtitles anywhere in the image.

sets.title: Gaji RM4,000 Duduk KL Rasa Macam RM2,000 (Kos Hidup Bandar Raya)
sets.arc: Sinopsis Arka 3 Scene: Keluarga kucing di bandar raya tertekan dengan kos sewa rumah, tiket parkir, tol dan makanan luar yang menelan seluruh gaji tanpa sempat menabung. Scene 2 menunjukkan Ibu Calico mula menyusun bekal makanan dan memotong langganan membazir. Scene 3 menampilkan hos wanita menegur kebocoran kos hidup bandar dan memperkenalkan akaun GAP serendah RM100 sebagai cara mengunci gaji sebelum dihabiskan bandar.
sets.persona: Kos hidup tinggi di KL & bandar besar

Header: Kunci Kuasa Beli Bandar dengan Akaun GAP — Storyboard Infographic
Legend
Include a small legend with icons for:
- Action
- Reaction
- Time
- Key Object
Main Character / Subject
Malaysian woman in her late 20s to early 30s with an approachable, professional, and trustworthy presence. She wears an elegant, modest long-sleeved outfit and a stylishly wrapped hijab with clean neat folds. Her outer top always has full-length long sleeves reaching all the way down to the wrists - never three-quarter, never rolled up, never pushed back. Underneath the sleeves she wears plain close-fitting inner handsocks in a neutral color matching the outfit, visible only as a narrow cuff peeking out at the wrists and covering the wrists; her forearms are never exposed.
Storyboard
1. Opener - WIDE SHOT
Action: Malaysian woman standing in a stylish home living room, gesturing toward a small neat pile of urban utility and rent receipts on a coffee table.
Emotion: Approachable, relatable
Time: 0:00–0:01.25
Key Object: Resit sewa dan bil bandar
2. Setup - MEDIUM SHOT
Action: Woman looks directly into camera with understanding empathy, holding up the stack of bills to illustrate living expenses.
Dialogue: "Tengok resit belanja bandar ni."
Emotion: Empathetic, earnest
Time: 0:01.25–0:02.5
Key Object: Timbunan resit
3. First Action - CLOSE SHOT
Action: Woman gestures firmly with both hands, shaking head gently at the painful reality of rapid urban cash drainage.
Dialogue: "Gaji masuk terus licin terbakar!"
Emotion: Firm, awakening
Time: 0:02.5–0:03.75
Key Object: Ekspresi tegas
4. Turning Point - DYNAMIC SHOT
Action: Cinematic visual transition from paper slips to a solid, inflation-proof physical gold bar.
Details: Split frame showing the contrast: vanishing cash receipts on one side versus a gleaming 1 gram Public Gold minted bar resting on an authorized certificate.
Emotion: Revealing, reassuring
Time: 0:03.75–0:05
Key Object: Jongkong emas 1 gram Public Gold
5. Progress - MEDIUM SHOT
Action: Woman brings up her smartphone displaying the verified Public Gold GAP digital ledger showing consistent gram accumulation.
Dialogue: "Kunci awal dalam akaun GAP."
Emotion: Confident, educational
Time: 0:05–0:06.25
Key Object: Aplikasi GAP pada telefon
6. Unique Angle - TOP SHOT
Action: Direct overhead shot of the clean wooden table showing the smartphone screen beside the shining 1g gold bar.
Emotion: Clear, structured
Time: 0:06.25–0:07.5
Key Object: Telefon dan jongkong emas dari atas
7. Final Action - CLOSE SHOT
Action: Woman smiles warmly into the lens, holding the 1 gram gold card securely between her fingers at chest level.
Emotion: Warm, encouraging
Time: 0:07.5–0:08.75
Key Object: Kad emas 1 gram 999.9
8. Reveal - HERO SHOT
Action: Woman raises the gleaming Public Gold bar toward the camera with a radiant, resolute smile, delivering her closing advice.
Dialogue: "Selamatkan gaji anda sekarang!"
Emotion: Empowering, decisive
Time: 0:08.75–0:10
Key Object: Jongkong emas diangkat ke kamera
Requirements
- Total runtime: 10 seconds across exactly 8 distinct panels.
- Sleeves stay full length down to the wrists in every panel, with plain inner handsocks showing only as a narrow cuff at the wrists. Never three-quarter sleeves, never rolled-up sleeves, never bare forearms.
- Do not include a piggy bank anywhere in the storyboard.
- Dialogue text shown in the poster should be in Bahasa Melayu exactly as given above - do not translate to English.
- Maintain consistent character facial features, hijab styling, and outfit across all panels.
Output
Output only the completed storyboard infographic poster in a 1:1.414 portrait aspect ratio.
